implementation_sequence: Actual redacted evidence and status report

packages.title: Consent and purpose checks
packages.acceptance_scenarios: Witness grant, missing consent, withdrawal and queued/offline replay across backend, FHIR, PWA, AI and marketing. Verify permissible other-lawful-basis processing remains available.
packages.evidence_after_implementation: A01-consent-exhibit.pdf; A01-purpose-cases.csv; A01-enforcement-results.json; tenant-configuration.json. Include notice version, exact event times and test identities.
packages.manual_acceptance: Approve purpose/legal-basis map and consent wording. Reviewer checks every enabled path and tenant/template. Refresh when purposes, notices, callers or enforcement settings change.
packages.history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
packages.implemented_controls: Consent records capture exact notice/version, actor and event time. Purpose lookup includes AI, support, analytics, training and audio recording. Immutable selected recipients bind AI transmission. Photo/audio upload gates run before storage. PWA and backend expose notice/recipient controls.
packages.remaining_actions: Approve notices, representative authority and lawful exceptions; arrange actual provider destinations before AI/speech use.

packages.title: Clinical author and correction integrity
packages.acceptance_scenarios: Attempt author/order relinking, content change and deletion/cascade through UI and APIs. Demonstrate original preservation, addendum export and offline identity attribution.
packages.evidence_after_implementation: A02-note-addendum-exhibit.pdf; A02-mutation-results.json; original-and-addendum.json; SHA-256 manifest. Use synthetic clinical records.
packages.manual_acceptance: Clinical reviewer approves late-entry/correction policy; security reviewer checks privileged access boundaries. Refresh after authoring, sync or schema changes.
packages.history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
packages.implemented_controls: Authenticated finalization issues a v2 clinical seal over care time, correction reason, identity, audio and coding sidecars. RPC-created signatures and client-context bypasses are refused. Author/order/content lock after finalization; corrections use addenda. Existing v1 verification remains unchanged.
packages.remaining_actions: Approve clinician identity and supervisor permissions. Legacy missing event times remain missing.

packages.title: Protected audit trail
packages.acceptance_scenarios: Generate login/logout, clinical read/create/change/delete, support and API events; reconcile all expected events and proxy metadata. Attempt unauthorised alteration and retrieve archived logs.
packages.evidence_after_implementation: A03-event-coverage.csv; audit-sample.ndjson; A03-tamper-and-retrieval.pdf; protected-store and retention configuration with access review.
packages.manual_acceptance: Security reviewer witnesses coverage and protection against relevant administrator roles. Evidence archive configuration and ongoing log continuity; a fresh deployment cannot prove 12 elapsed months of retained history.
packages.history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
packages.implemented_controls: Healthcare ORM read/fetch/create/write/delete, partner reads, clinical signing and attachment streaming emit structured actor/time/record/result events without content. AUTHPRIV syslog is independent of the request transaction.
packages.remaining_actions: Configure and witness log collection, retention, access and independent/off-host protection. Direct SQL, external systems and all export channels still require coverage review; local logs are not proof against infrastructure administrators.

packages.title: Encryption and key custody
packages.acceptance_scenarios: Inspect DB, filestore, audio, temporary/export copies, replicas and backups. Verify TLS, encrypted artifacts, legacy migration, separation of keys, rotation and controlled recovery.
packages.evidence_after_implementation: A04-storage-coverage.csv; A04-TLS-report.pdf; redacted key/rotation records; migration results; encrypted-backup and recovery test report.
packages.manual_acceptance: Infrastructure and security approve the estate/key inventory. A screenshot or encrypted field alone is insufficient. Refresh on storage, key, provider or encryption changes; schedule periodic checks.
packages.history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
packages.implemented_controls: Sensitive healthcare attachments use AES-256-GCM with transparent HTTP delivery and unchanged plaintext checksums. Scribe transcripts, correction reasons and AI coding payloads are encrypted; legacy plaintext columns are migrated without changing seals. Backup pairs use an external root-owned key.
packages.remaining_actions: Production disk/database encryption, independent key escrow, custody and rotation must be arranged. Existing PHI derivation is preserved; database.secret remains available to an authorised DB administrator.

packages.title: Retention, holds and erasure
packages.acceptance_scenarios: Use boundary-date fixtures for each approved class; refuse deletion of held/retained records and whole tenants. Prove lawful purge, attachment removal, backup expiry and restore suppression.
packages.evidence_after_implementation: A05-retention-hold-tests.json; approved-schedule.pdf; disposal-approval.pdf; scoped-erasure-report.pdf; backup-expiry and restore-suppression results.
packages.manual_acceptance: Custodian/DPO approves trigger dates, exceptions and custody. Demonstrate configuration, boundary tests and sustainable contracts; do not claim a test proves decades of elapsed storage or physical erasure of unverified media.
packages.history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
packages.implemented_controls: Company-scoped retention/legal holds stop linked healthcare-record and patient deletion. Released holds retain history. Tenant closure requires an explicit custodian approval reference and no active hold. No automatic clinical destruction is enabled.
packages.remaining_actions: Custodian/legal team must approve retention classes, schedule, exceptions, archive custody and each destruction procedure. Final clinical notes remain locked; a reviewed statutory disposition service is future work if required.

packages.title: Readable complete exports and archives
packages.acceptance_scenarios: Export notes, addenda, attachments, consent and required metadata. Reconcile counts/checksums and open the archive independently of the current service; test representative format migrations.
packages.evidence_after_implementation: A06-synthetic-export.zip; manifest.csv; schema-and-format-guide.pdf; A06-independent-read-test.pdf; signed custody/exit terms.
packages.manual_acceptance: Receiving custodian witnesses readability and completeness. Refresh on export/schema/format changes; periodically rehearse retrieval and key preservation. A successful export is not a statutory national-interface submission.
packages.history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
packages.implemented_controls: Restricted manager archive exports patient-linked healthcare/BHYT records, linked files, readable HTML, JSON and per-file SHA-256 manifest. Clinical integrity is verified before publication. Unsupported models and scope limits are explicit.
packages.remaining_actions: Reconcile the exported model inventory, fields, binary evidence, financial/chatter/external records and approved form set before calling an archive complete. PDF/PDF-A archival profiles and external records remain additional work where applicable.

packages.title: Data-subject request handling
packages.acceptance_scenarios: Run request-specific access/deletion/withdrawal cases with reproducible clocks, processor handoffs, justified extensions and statutory-retention refusal. Use an integrated controlled case tool if suitable.
packages.evidence_after_implementation: A07-request-timeline.csv; redacted case-exhibit.pdf; A07-timer-tests.json; identity/refusal/extension procedures and notification records.
packages.manual_acceptance: DPO signs the applicable response rules and case outcome. Refresh when rules or workflows change and sample real closed cases periodically; simulated tests do not show all real requests met deadlines.
packages.history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
packages.implemented_controls: Rights cases calculate Article 5 acknowledgement/completion clocks, distinguish processor involvement, enforce one justified extension with actual notice proof, and preserve acknowledgement/outcome proof. Company-scoped holiday calendar supports working-day deadlines.
packages.remaining_actions: Publish request procedures, verify identity, configure Vietnamese holidays, communicate outcomes and review legal exceptions. Workflow actions record actual communications; they do not send them.

packages.manual_acceptance: Legal/clinical owner selects the lawful method by document. No personal signing key enters the pack. Refresh on provider, signing component, standards or method changes; retain long-term verification material.
packages.history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.

packages.remaining_actions: Select accredited CA/equivalent lawful mechanism, obtain approved signing profile, implement its driver and validate certificates/timestamps/revocation before a certified-signing claim.
